edges.reason: msg.sender is resolved through admin role and owner checks in _isAdmin
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender, establishing the owner privilege
_isAdmin reads contractManager to resolve SkaleManager and read the ADMIN_ROLE
upgrade casts an arbitrary address and calls setCompleted on the new contract
restricted modifier requires msg.sender to equal the stored owner
owner state variable is compared with the caller in the restricted modifier
setCompleted is restricted by comparing msg.sender with owner
adjustPrice gates execution on now > lastUpdated + COOLDOWN_TIME, a timestamp dependency
price.change is computed with nested mul/sub/div over load and capacity
price is increased or decreased by priceChange with add/sub operations
lastUpdated is written with the current now value
capacity is a local aggregate of online nodes and total space per node
load is computed locally by iterating schains and node parts
sendValue performs a low-level value call forwarding all available gas
the caller-supplied recipient controls the target of the external call
amount is passed as the value of the low-level call
a malicious recipient can re-enter the calling contract while the call is in flight
slash performs an external call to DelegationController.confiscate
allow("SkaleDKG") validates msg.sender against contractManager.contracts
confiscate mutates delegation state and slashing log after the external call context
forgive writes the _locked mapping of an arbitrary holder
onlyAdmin modifier authorizes msg.sender before forgiving
reduceValue and reduceSequence perform unchecked multiplications and divisions on stake
amount is used to lock pending delegations and later accounting
validatorId drives authorization, statistics and first-month tracking
a new delegation is appended to the delegations array
delegate fetches the current month from TimeHelpers for accounting
getCurrentMonth derives its result from the block timestamp
tokensReceived forwards the token value and userData into Schains.addSchain
addSchain requires now >= schainCreationTimeStamp, a timestamp dependency
broadcast requires the node index to be owned by msg.sender
nodeIndex parameter identifies the broadcasting node in the channel
verificationVector is hashed and stored in KeyStorage
channel broadcast flags and counters are updated during broadcast
complaint paths invoke _finalizeSlashing once the time window expires
complaint compares block.timestamp against COMPLAINT_TIMELIMIT windows
response validates the encrypted share then finalizes the slashing
_finalizeSlashing calls Punisher.slash after rotating the node and touching SchainsInternal
successful DKG completion records the last successful DKG timestamp
mint increases _totalSupply and balances with SafeMath
mint calls the recipient ERC777 hook after updating balances and supply
the ReentrancyGuard _status flag protects the token hooks
a registered recipient implementer can re-enter mint/transfer through the hook
approveTransfer mutates the approved mapping for the target wallet
_totalApproved is adjusted with add/sub on the approved delta
onlySeller modifier checks msg.sender against owner or SELLER_ROLE
retrieve reads and zeroes the caller approved amount
value holds the approved amount before transfer and locking
retrieve requires approved[msg.sender] > 0 before paying out
from parameter identifies the node owner recorded by SkaleManager
params carries the validated node creation data into _addNode
space subtraction mutates spaceOfNodes and the space-to-nodes mapping
node counters are decremented without an explicit underflow guard
nodeIndex selects the node used for stage pool and downtime math
_stagePool.sub(bounty) can revert or mis-account on insufficient pool
_stagePool is rewritten after the subtraction
_nodesRemainingPerRewardPeriod is decremented on every bounty
bounty sizing depends on now versus reward periods, deltas and deadlines
createNode binds the node to msg.sender as the validator node address
allow("SkaleToken") resolves the trusted token address from contractManager

normalization_plan.reason: capacity is only a temporary aggregate consumed inside adjustPrice
load is a temporary aggregate computed and consumed inside adjustPrice
amount only exists to be passed as the call value inside sendValue
recipient is the call target inside sendValue and must be folded into it
amount parameter is only used for delegation accounting within delegate
validatorId parameter is only used for validator checks within delegate
nodeIndex exists only to bind the sender to a channel slot in broadcast
verificationVector is only hashed and forwarded inside broadcast
value is a local copy of the approved amount used only within retrieve
from is only written into the new node record inside createNode
params is the structured argument consumed only by createNode and _addNode
nodeIndex parameter is only consumed by the bounty math inside getBounty
